module: Extension that keeps the speed camera leaderboards (top 10), per level and per camera (triggerName), in freeroam mode only. Leaderboards are loaded from settings/cloud/speedTrapLeaderboards/<level>.json at level start and saved at the end of the mission or before career mode activation. An entry contains speed (m/s), modelName (JBeam name) and date (UTC ISO 8601).
usage: local isBest, board = gameplay_speedTrapLeaderboards.addRecord(data, vehSpeed, overSpeed, veh)
notes: Automatic loading and saving only if the game state is "freeroam" and career is not active.
Only levels marked "dirty" (new record added) are rewritten, unless forceOverwrite.
onSerialize uses career_career.isActive() without checking that career_career exists; if the extension is absent, a Lua error is possible.
The code comment notes the absence of an "onFreeroamStart" hook: loading is done on onClientPostStartMission.

addRecord.desc: Adds an entry to the current level's camera leaderboard if there is room (10 entries max) or if it beats the last entry, then sorts by descending speed.

overSpeed.desc: Speed limit excess in m/s (not used for the entry).

veh.desc: Vehicle object (its JBeam field gives the model).

returns.desc: true if the speed equals or exceeds the leaderboard's best score.
level -> camera -> list of entries {speed, modelName, date}.

loadLeaderboards.desc: Clears memory then loads all *.json files of the folder; the file name without extension is used as the level name.

saveLeaderboards.desc: Writes the modified leaderboards to disk (one file per level).

forceOverwrite.desc: Write all levels, even unmodified ones.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook called after a level starts: in freeroam, loads the leaderboards.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the mission: in freeroam, saves the leaderboards.

onBeforeCareerActivate.desc: Hook called before career activation: in freeroam, saves.

onSerialize.desc: Saves the state before a Lua reload (leaderboards and modified levels); returns nothing if career is active.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the state after a Lua reload.
